reason: A configuration-only DSH plugin that presents the read-only permission preset as Plan mode, enforces a planning-first workflow, blocks permission escalation, and preserves web search.

summaries.zh: 将 DSH 的只读权限预设显示为 Plan 模式，禁止权限升级并保留网页搜索，以支持先调研和制定计划再手动切换权限执行。
summaries.en: Presents DSH's read-only permission preset as Plan mode, blocks permission escalation, and keeps web search available for research and planning before manual execution.

capabilities: Modifies the DSH permission preset configuration
Allows read-only access to the filesystem
Keeps web_search available in the read-only preset
